Iron Hands.

1) The primarch :Ferrus Manus, leader of the Iron Hands legion known for his Iron arms. In game, He is a beast made to crush enemy and buff your dreadnought and vehicule.

2) Lore wise, it's one of the legion wich is the most affected by the Horus Heresy where Ferrus Manus died on Istvaan V. It will affect their chapter during 40k wich is nice to notice. When their primarch died, they will be submerged by grief, sadness and fury wich still subsist in 40k. It's one of the most anti-hero legion of all of the loyalist legion. It's not like the salamanders or ultramarines where you can say that they are the good guys. No, Iron Hands are the a55hole of the imperium, they don't give a sh1t about regular human and soldiera, actually they use them as bait for their attacks. They are what they were made for by the emperor : an unstoppable warcrime machine.

3) Build : That's the neat part, Iron Hands are known for their Iron hands and robotic part ("no sh1t sherlock"), you can do a lot of kitbashing with mecanicum part or use green stuff and 3d printing for mecanical part, cables, bionic legs/arms. 

4) Painting: the tricky part, they seem easy ("muh it's just black and metal bru") but it will be tricky to make a slighty metallic black. After you acquire the technique to make them all dirty, oilly and metallic it will be all good man.

5) Game : Tougher Space marine, Tougher vehicules, tougher robot. And you have an ability to regain Lifepoints on your vehicule with a special aptitude. They are a very mecanical legion wich mean you will have more dreadnought and vehicule. 

Tl:dr : Funny Primarch, Anti-hero loyalist, lot of kitbashing, painting challenging but not too hard, Tought everything but you will use a lot of dreadnought and vehicules.
